content.title: Pet Sitting Near Me: Find The Best Pet Sitters | Rover.com
content.text: About: I’ve been around dogs and pets my whole life, so caring for them just feels natural to me. I was the “go-to” person in my neighborhood growing up, for house sitting, boarding and walking! I’m comfortable with all kinds of personalities and needs, from high energy dogs to seniors. I’ve handled things like feeding routines, giving medications, and just making sure pets feel safe, happy, and cared for. I have a dog of my own, and I also grew up with a reactive dog. I know firsthand how much patience and consistency training takes. I’m not a certified trainer, but I’ve spent a lot of time working on behavior, leash skills, and obedience using positive reinforcement. Over time, I was able to build solid listening, reliable recall, and off leash trust, so that experience really helps me connect with dogs who need a little extra understanding. I’m reliable easy to communicate with. I truly enjoy what I do. Whether it’s walks, drop in visits, or just hanging out with your pet, I’ll treat them like my own and can keep you in the loop along the way. Pet care fits naturally into my daily routine, and I make it a priority in my schedule. I’m currently working part time, which gives me plenty of flexibility, and I’m available from 9 AM to 5 PM. I’m happy to adjust my hours to fit your pet’s routine or any special needs, whether that’s multiple visits, check-ins, or last-minute requests. My goal is to build strong, lasting relationships with both pets and their owners while keeping care reliable, easy, and stress free for everyone. Here’s a concise, profile-ready version that keeps it human, professional, and safety-focused: Safety, trust, and comfort are my top priorities when caring for pets. On walks, I use properly fitted collars or harnesses, monitor behavior, avoid hazards, and carry water, waste bags, and medications as needed. During in-home visits, I ensure the space is secure, follow feeding and exercise routines, and can safely administer medications. I stay calm, attentive, and communicative, keeping owners updated on any concerns or changes. My goal is to provide a reliable, stress-free, and positive experience for every pet in my care.
